page.overview:
Who is Vaedermakar?

A vaedermakar is a type of druid who is skilled in manipulating the weather, particularly the one knowing Song of the Sky. Such a druid can call or stop a storm, cause hail, make lightning turn enemy to ash. They do these through a ritual made through animal sacrifice and chants on a sacrificial altar. The cost of these rituals invoke the summoning of waves of foglets though so vaedermakars are only called upon when people's needs are great rather than on a whim.
